title: Deinterlacing
text: 去除隔行扫描效应，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Method} 指定去隔行方法 Line；{Input image is transposed (data order is row major)} 指定数据顺序、{Rounding mode} 指定计算定点值时的舍入模式、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定溢出模式、{Accumulator} 指定累加器数据类型 Binary point、{Output} 输出的数据类型 Same、{Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} 指定数据类型覆盖，按实例取值。

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: 隔行扫描输入 numeric matrix | 3-D numeric array | image | video

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: 去隔行输出 numeric matrix | 3-D numeric array | image | video

params.name: Method
params.values: 去隔行方法 Line repetition (default) | Linear interpolation | Vertical temporal median filtering

params.name: Input image is transposed (data order is row major)
params.values: 指定数据顺序 off (default) | on

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 计算定点值时的舍入模式 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 指定溢出模式 on (default) | off

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: 累加器数据类型 Binary point scaling (default) | Same as input

params.name: Output
params.values: 输出的数据类型 Same as input (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 数据类型覆盖 off (default) | on
